CreateService.instanceId: AI Gateway instance ID, located in the path
CreateService.X-Region: Region code, e.g. bj, gz, su, cd, yq, bd
CreateService.serviceSource: Service source: CCE, MSE, FIXED_IP, DNS_DOMAIN, CFC, AI_PROXY
CreateService.namespace: Service namespace; defaults to "default" for AI_PROXY
CreateService.serviceName: Service name for FIXED_IP, DNS_DOMAIN, or AI_PROXY
CreateService.clusterIds: List of CCE multi-cluster binding IDs
CreateService.serviceList.clusterIds: List of cluster IDs bound to the service
CreateService.serviceAddresses: List of fixed IP or DNS addresses in host:port format
CreateService.provider: AI_PROXY model provider, e.g. QIANFAN, DEEPSEEK, OPENAI
CreateService.endpoint: Model provider endpoint; Qianfan uses https://qianfan.baidubce.com/v2
CreateService.apiKeys: List of model provider API keys; not allowed in IAM mode
CreateService.credentialSource: AI_PROXY credential source: DEFAULT or IAM
